svg.text: Move the surveyed board through a 3D volume.
Example for CAM3 | Six sequential placements of one movable board, not six required physical boards.
Source: vehicle_camera_calibration_measurement_plan.md | Illustrative geometry; no measured camera poses.
Schematic perspective: dimensions, camera height, poses and target positions are illustrative.
All four extreme inner corners (or verified offset fiducials) are surveyed at each placement.
At least six placements per camera.
Use two or more distances, several directions,
varied heights, depths and board tilts.
Keep all 7 x 10 inner corners readable.
Recheck a control for board motion.
